_comment: Test status per box of docs/architecture_*.svg, read by docs/gen_architecture.py.
The dot says one thing: is this module functionally tested on silicon with the current version?
status:   tested  = yes (green) - needs rev and evidence;
pending = not tested with this version yet (grey ring) - no verdict on whether it works.
rev:      the git revision it was tested at. A tested box whose files changed since rev
is drawn pending again by itself.
evidence: where the test is written down: 'board run <zip>' (--apply-run) or a dated
docs/HARDWARE-LOG.md entry (--mark-tested REV EVIDENCE BOX...); for a pending box,
what is known from earlier versions.
files:    its source files (for the check above).
blocks:   the board-run blocks (tools/board_run.py, R0..R7) that exercise it: --apply-run marks
a box tested when every one passed in B with no deviation and 'open' is empty.
open:     parts in scope that no test reaches yet, or findings still open (docs/TEST-COVERAGE.md) -
offboard: true = a test without a board covers it too (host test, trace, simulator).
